12/5 7:40am

SR-190 & SR-210 FORECAST

6am(12/5) – 6pm(12/5): Snow through the day, heavier after 5pm. 2-4″ of road snow for upper canyons, with 1″ for lower canyon.

6pm(12/5) – 6am(12/6): Heavy snow all night. 9-15″ road snow in upper canyons & 4-8″ in mid possible.

12/5 7:20am

SR-210 ROAD CONDITIONS

Lower-upper: heavy slush and snow covered 

watch for slick spots, especially at Tanners Flat (MP 8.1)

BE ALERT: crews are out. Travel with caution to/from Snowbird, Alta Ski Area, and Town of Alta

12/5 6:55am

SR-190 REMINDER: Parking reservations required for Town of Brighton

Plan ahead and check their website for details.

Please obey all posted signage and park to the right of the white line.

Salt Lake County parking fines range from $75-$150

12/5 6:50am

SR-190 ROAD CONDITIONS

Lower-Mid: slush/snow sticking 

Upper: heavy slush/snow covered

Snowfall is heaviest in lower canyon, be cautious of low visibility.

Crews are out: travel delays are possible this AM to Solitude Mountain and Brighton Resort.

12/5 6:14am

Traction Law IN EFFECT: SR-190 & SR-210 

DRIVE ACCORDING TO CONDITIONS 

Expect delays

Reduce your speed 

Don’t drive distracted

Maintain adequate space with vehicle in front of you

Give plows space & don’t pass them

12/5 6:14am

Traction Law Alert

Traction Law IN EFFECT for both Big & Little Cottonwood Canyons (SR-190, SR-210)

Travel with caution and make sure your vehicles are properly equipped

Applies to both travel directions (up/down)

The Traction Law is in effect for both Big & Little Cottonwood Canyons (SR-190/SR-210) and applies to both travel directions. Traction devices are required for all vehicles, for requirements click here.

12/4 4:30pm

SR-190 & SR-210

Be prepared for changing conditions to/from Solitude Mountain, Brighton Resort, Alta, and Snowbird

Make sure your vehicles are properly equipped before entering canyons or wait for UTA ski bus.

12/4 4:28pm

SR-190 & SR-210 FORECAST

Weather-related travel delays likely (12/5)

1-2 feet of road snow may be possible near resorts from Friday night into Saturday.

12/4 4:28pm

Road Weather Alert

SR-190 & SR-210 PLAN AHEAD

6pm(12/4) – 6am(12/5): Snow begins after 10pm becoming steadier after midnight. 2-3″ road snow in upper canyons and 1″ in lower canyons.

6am(12/5) – 6pm(12/5): Periods of snow through the day, heavier after 5am. 3-6″ of road snow in upper canyons, w/ 2-4″ for lower canyons.

Be prepared & drive to conditions.
